item.title: Architecture-enabled expansion and enhancement of piezoelectric tensor components in GaN
item.description:
Authors: Jun Cai, Pengxu Lu, Youjian Li, Xin Chen, Agus P. Sasmito, Abdolhamid Akbarzadeh

Spinodal-inspired orientation mixing and nanoscale porosity expand the piezoelectric tensor of GaN while enhancing its electromechanical response.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00302h

item.title: Nanomaterial-driven drug repositioning: design strategies, regulatory mechanisms, and biomedical applications
item.description:
Authors: Junlie Yao, Xiaoting Zhang, Xiaobang Liu, Zi Liu, Feng Wang, Lingzhi Zhang, Yanxia Yu, Yan Chen, Huae Xu

This review offers an integrated perspective on nanomaterial-driven drug repositioning across design strategies, regulatory mechanisms, and biomedical applications.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00326e

item.title: Retraction: Similarity modulation mechanism in triboelectric nanogenerators
item.description:
Authors: Bochao Xie, Yingying Ma, Yihuang Xie

Retraction of ‘Similarity modulation mechanism in triboelectric nanogenerators’ by Bochao Xie et al. , Nanoscale Horiz. , 2026, 11 , 1391–1396, https://doi.org/10.1039/d5nh00624d.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh90050j

item.title: Site-specific hydrogen adsorption on GaAs-supported dual-atom catalysts: first-principles insights and interpretable modeling
item.description:
Authors: Xin Dai, Zhengli Zhang, Zhao Ding, Xiang Guo, Youfen Chen, Xuefei Liu, Zijiang Luo, Yi Wang

DFT and interpretable machine learning reveal site-specific H adsorption in GaAs-supported dual-atom catalysts, identifying eight near-thermoneutral candidates and the local factors governing Δ G H* .

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00400h
